name: poly_decay_summable
doc: p > 1 ⟹ Σ_{t≥0} 1/(t+1)^p 收敛（引用 mathlib 的 nat rpow 判别法 + 平移）。
stmt:
theorem poly_decay_summable (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ p)
proof:
by
  have hbase : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) :=
    (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow).mpr hp
  have hshift := (summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ p) 1).mpr hbase
  simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hshift

name: linear_lr_one_not_summable
doc: 调和级数 Σ 1/(t+1) 发散（p = 1 处的临界判别）。
stmt:
theorem linear_lr_one_not_summable :
    ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
by
  intro hs
  have hbase : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
    intro h
    have hp := (Real.summable_one_div_nat_rpow (p := 1)).mp (by simpa using h)
    exact lt_irrefl (1 : ℝ) hp
  apply hbase
  have hs' : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (fun m : ℕ => 1 / (m : ℝ)) (n + 1)) := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hs
  exact (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp hs'

name: linear_lr_not_summable
doc: η₀ > 0 ⟹ η_t = η₀/(t+1) 不可求和（Σ η_t = ∞）。
stmt:
theorem linear_lr_not_summable (η₀ : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η₀) :
    ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ => η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
proof:
by
  intro hs
  have h2 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => η₀⁻¹ * (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) :=
    Summable.mul_left η₀⁻¹ hs
  have hfun : (fun n : ℕ => η₀⁻¹ * (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)))
      = fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    funext n
    have hc : η₀⁻¹ * η₀ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hη)
    calc
      η₀⁻¹ * (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) = (η₀⁻¹ * η₀) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
      _ = 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by rw [hc]
  rw [hfun] at h2
  exact linear_lr_one_not_summable h2

name: small_error_of_summable_weighted
stmt:
theorem small_error_of_summable_weighted {e η : ℕ → ℝ}
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n => η n * e n)) (hηns : ¬ Summable η) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, e n < ε
proof:
by
  intro ε hε
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
                     
  have hle : ∀ n, η n * ε ≤ η n * e n :=
    fun n => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h n) (hη n)
  have hnonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n * ε := fun n => mul_nonneg (hη n) (le_of_lt hε)
  have hsum' : Summable (fun n => η n * ε) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le hnonneg hle hsum
  apply hηns
  have h2 : Summable (fun n => ε⁻¹ * (η n * ε)) := Summable.mul_left ε⁻¹ hsum'
  have hfun : (fun n => ε⁻¹ * (η n * ε)) = η := by
    funext n
    have hc : ε⁻¹ * ε = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hε)
    calc
      ε⁻¹ * (η n * ε) = (ε⁻¹ * ε) * η n := by ring
      _ = η n := by rw [hc, one_mul]
  rwa [hfun] at h2

name: harmonic_lr_small_error
doc: 特化：η_t = η₀/(t+1)（调和衰减），Σ η_t·e_t 收敛 ⟹ 存在任意小误差。
stmt:
theorem harmonic_lr_small_error {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η₀)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (η₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * e n)) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, e n < ε
proof:
small_error_of_summable_weighted he
    (fun n => div_nonneg (le_of_lt hη0) (by positivity))
    hsum (linear_lr_not_summable η₀ hη0)

name: lr_decay_antitone
doc: 衰减调度下误差单调不增：0 ≤ η_n ≤ 1，e ≥ 0，e(n+1) ≤ (1-η_n)e_n。
stmt:
theorem lr_decay_antitone {e η : ℕ → ℝ}
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n) (_hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n) :
    Antitone e
proof:
by
  apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
  intro n
  calc
    e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n := hdec n
    _ ≤ 1 * e n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hη0 n]) (he n)
    _ = e n := one_mul _

name: decay_product_bound
stmt:
theorem decay_product_bound {e η : ℕ → ℝ}
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (_hη0 : ∀ n, 0 ≤ η n) (hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N ≤ e 0 * ∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t)
proof:
by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
      have hfac : 0 ≤ 1 - η N := by linarith [hη1 N]
      calc
        e (N + 1) ≤ (1 - η N) * e N := hdec N
        _ ≤ (1 - η N) * (e 0 * ∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hfac
        _ = e 0 * ∏ t in Finset.range (N + 1), (1 - η t) := by
              rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
              ring

name: lr_decay_finite_phase
doc:
几何阶段保证：前 N 步若 η_t ≥ c（0 ≤ c ≤ 1），则 e_N ≤ (1-c)^N·e_0。
连接 RealConvergence.contraction_pow_bound。
stmt:
theorem lr_decay_finite_phase {e η : ℕ → ℝ} (c : ℝ)
    (_hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hηc : ∀ n, c ≤ η n) (_hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N ≤ (1 - c) ^ N * e 0
proof:
by
  apply contraction_pow_bound (1 - c) (by linarith)
  intro n
  calc
    e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η n) * e n := hdec n
    _ ≤ (1 - c) * e n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hηc n]) (he n)

name: constant_lr_converges
doc: p = 0（常数学习率 η_t ≡ η₀ ∈ (0,1)）时回收几何收敛：ε-终止。
stmt:
theorem constant_lr_converges {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < η₀) (h1 : η₀ < 1)
    (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hdec : ∀ n, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η₀) * e n) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n : ℕ, e n < ε
proof: contraction_converges (1 - η₀) (by linarith) (by linarith) hdec he

name: product_exp_bound
stmt:
theorem product_exp_bound (η : ℕ → ℝ) (hη1 : ∀ n, η n ≤ 1) (N : ℕ) :
    (∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t))
      ≤ Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η t))
proof:
by
  have hprod : (∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t))
      ≤ ∏ t in Finset.range N, Real.exp (-(η t)) :=
    Finset.prod_le_prod (fun t _ => by linarith [hη1 t])
      (fun t _ => Real.one_sub_le_exp_neg (η t))
  calc
    (∏ t in Finset.range N, (1 - η t))
        ≤ ∏ t in Finset.range N, Real.exp (-(η t)) := hprod
    _ = Real.exp (∑ t in Finset.range N, -(η t)) := (Real.exp_sum _ _).symm
    _ = Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η t)) := by rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: sqrt_inv_le_two_sub
stmt:
theorem sqrt_inv_le_two_sub (n : ℕ) :
    1 / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1)
      ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))
proof:
by
  set a := Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) with ha
  set b := Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) with hb
  have ha0 : 0 < a := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (by positivity)
  have hba : b ≤ a := by
    rw [ha, hb]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hden : 0 < a + b := by
    have : 0 ≤ b := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    linarith
  have hmul : (a - b) * (a + b) = 1 := by
    have hexp : (a - b) * (a + b) = a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hexp, ha, hb, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    ring
  have hsub : a - b = 1 / (a + b) := (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hden)).mpr hmul
  have hstep : 1 / a ≤ 2 / (a + b) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ ha0 hden]
    linarith
  calc
    1 / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) = 1 / a := by rw [ha]
    _ ≤ 2 / (a + b) := hstep
    _ = 2 * (a - b) := by rw [hsub]; ring
    _ = 2 * (Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) := by rw [ha, hb]

name: sum_sqrt_range
stmt:
theorem sum_sqrt_range (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range N, (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ)))
      = Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have h := Finset.sum_range_sub (f := fun t : ℕ => Real.sqrt (t : ℝ)) N
  simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using h

name: sqrt_decay
doc: √t 调度的累计步长界（sqrt_decay）：Σ_{t<N} η₀/√(t+1) ≤ 2·η₀·√N。
stmt:
theorem sqrt_decay (η₀ : ℝ) (hη₀ : 0 ≤ η₀) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))
      ≤ 2 * η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
proof:
by
  have hterm : ∀ t ∈ Finset.range N,
      η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)
        ≤ η₀ * (2 * (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) := by
    intro t _
    calc
      η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)
          = η₀ * (1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)) := (mul_one_div η₀ _).symm
      _ ≤ η₀ * (2 * (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sqrt_inv_le_two_sub t) hη₀
  calc
    (∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))
        ≤ ∑ t in Finset.range N,
            η₀ * (2 * (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = η₀ * (2 * ∑ t in Finset.range N,
            (Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) - Real.sqrt (t : ℝ))) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = η₀ * (2 * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) := by rw [sum_sqrt_range]
    _ = 2 * η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := by ring

name: sqrt_decay_rate
doc: 显式率（以累计步长表示）：e_N ≤ e₀·exp(-Σ_{t<N} η_t)。
stmt:
theorem sqrt_decay_rate {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η₀)
    (hη1 : ∀ n : ℕ, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n : ℕ, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N
      ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)))
proof:
by
  intro N
  have hprod := decay_product_bound he
    (fun n => div_nonneg hη0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hη1 hdec N
  have hexp := product_exp_bound (fun t : ℕ => η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))
    hη1 N
  exact le_trans hprod (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (he 0))

name: sum_sqrt_inv_ge
stmt:
theorem sum_sqrt_inv_ge (N : ℕ) :
    Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ t in Finset.range N, 1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1)
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with hN | hN
  · subst hN
    simp
  · have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hden : 0 < Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos hNpos
    have hterm : ∀ t ∈ Finset.range N,
        1 / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) := by
      intro t ht
      have htN : t + 1 ≤ N := by
        have := Finset.mem_range.mp ht
        omega
      have hle : Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) ≤ Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by exact_mod_cast htN)
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (Real.sqrt_pos_of_pos (by positivity)) hle
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have hdiv : (N : ℝ) * (1 / Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) = Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hden)]
      rw [← sq, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hNpos)]
    linarith [hdiv ▸ hsum]

name: sqrt_decay_explicit
doc:
√t 调度的显式率（sqrt_decay 主结果）：
e_N ≤ e₀·exp(-η₀·√N)，即误差以 e^{-η₀√N} 速度衰减。
stmt:
theorem sqrt_decay_explicit {e : ℕ → ℝ} (η₀ : ℝ) (he : ∀ n, 0 ≤ e n) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η₀)
    (hη1 : ∀ n : ℕ, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1)
    (hdec : ∀ n : ℕ, e (n + 1) ≤ (1 - η₀ / Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ) + 1)) * e n) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, e N ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)))
proof:
by
  intro N
  have hrate := sqrt_decay_rate η₀ he hη0 hη1 hdec N
  have hge := sum_sqrt_inv_ge N
  have hsum_le : η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) := by
    calc
      η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)
          ≤ η₀ * ∑ t in Finset.range N, 1 / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hge hη0
      _ = ∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro t _
            ring
  calc
    e N ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(∑ t in Finset.range N, η₀ / Real.sqrt ((t : ℝ) + 1))) := hrate
    _ ≤ e 0 * Real.exp (-(η₀ * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)) (he 0)

                  
                                                       
                             
                    
                                                   
                                                     
                                                     
                                              
                                                  
                                                     
                     

end Lattice

name: linear_term_forces_zero
stmt:
lemma linear_term_forces_zero (c d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (h : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ 2 * t * c + t ^ 2 * d) :
    c = 0
proof:
by
  by_contra hc
  have ht : 0 ≤ 2 * (-c / (d + 1)) * c + (-c / (d + 1)) ^ 2 * d := h (-c / (d + 1))
  have hden : d + 1 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
  have hneg : 2 * (-c / (d + 1)) * c + (-c / (d + 1)) ^ 2 * d < 0 := by
    have hc2 : 0 < c ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hc
    have hnum : -d - 2 < 0 := by nlinarith
    have hdenpos : 0 < (d + 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero (by nlinarith : d + 1 ≠ 0)
    have heq : 2 * (-c / (d + 1)) * c + (-c / (d + 1)) ^ 2 * d = c ^ 2 * (-d - 2) / (d + 1) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [hden]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hc2 hnum) hdenpos
  exact (not_lt_of_ge ht) hneg

name: normal_equation_global_min
stmt:
theorem normal_equation_global_min (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ v : E, RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, A v⟫ = 0) :
    ∀ y : E, NormSqLossScalar A b x ≤ NormSqLossScalar A b y
proof:
by
  intro y
  unfold NormSqLossScalar
                             
  have hdecomp : A y - b = (A x - b) + A (y - x) := by
    calc
      A y - b = (A x - b) + (A y - A x) := by abel
      _ = (A x - b) + A (y - x) := by rw [← A.map_sub]
                                                                 
  have hsq := norm_add_sq (𝕜 := 𝕜) (A x - b) (A (y - x))
  rw [hdecomp, hsq, hx (y - x)]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖A (y - x)‖)]

name: residual_orthogonal_of_global_min
stmt:
theorem residual_orthogonal_of_global_min (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (x : E)
    (hx : ∀ y : E, NormSqLossScalar A b x ≤ NormSqLossScalar A b y) :
    ∀ v : E, RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, A v⟫ = 0
proof:
by
  intro v
                                                           
  have hgoal : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ 2 * t * RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, A v⟫ + t ^ 2 * ‖A v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro t
    have hineq := hx (x + t • v)
    unfold NormSqLossScalar at hineq
                                           
    have harg : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖A (x + t • v) - b‖ ^ 2 = ‖(A x - b) + t • (A v)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro t
      have hArg : A (x + t • v) - b = (A x - b) + t • A v := by
        calc
          A (x + t • v) - b = (A x + A (t • v)) - b := by rw [A.map_add]
          _ = (A x + t • A v) - b := by
                have hsmul : A (t • v) = t • A v := by
                  calc
                    A (t • v) = A ((t : 𝕜) • v) := by rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
                    _ = (t : 𝕜) • A v := A.map_smul (t : 𝕜) v
                    _ = t • A v := by rw [← RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
                rw [hsmul]
          _ = (A x - b) + t • A v := by abel
      rw [hArg]
    rw [harg t] at hineq
                                                             
    have hsq := norm_add_sq (𝕜 := 𝕜) (A x - b) (t • (A v))
    rw [hsq] at hineq
                                                                                
    have hre : RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, t • A v⟫ = t * RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, A v⟫ := by
      calc
        RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, t • A v⟫ = RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, (t : 𝕜) • A v⟫ := by
          rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := 𝕜)]
        _ = RCLike.re ((t : 𝕜) * ⟪A x - b,

name: satisfaction_global_min
stmt:
theorem satisfaction_global_min (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (x : E) (hx : A x = b) :
    ∀ y : E, NormSqLossScalar A b x ≤ NormSqLossScalar A b y
proof:
by
  intro y
  unfold NormSqLossScalar
  rw [hx]
  simpa using sq_nonneg (‖A y - b‖)

name: normal_equation_iff_global_min
stmt:
theorem normal_equation_iff_global_min (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (x : E) :
    (∀ v : E, RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, A v⟫ = 0) ↔ (∀ y : E, NormSqLossScalar A b x ≤ NormSqLossScalar A b y)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact normal_equation_global_min A b x
  · exact residual_orthogonal_of_global_min A b x

name: consistent_stationarity_iff_min
stmt:
theorem consistent_stationarity_iff_min (A : E →L[𝕜] F) (b : F) (x : E)
    (hb : b ∈ LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) :
    (fderiv ℝ (NormSqLossScalar A b) x = 0) ↔ (∀ y : E, NormSqLossScalar A b x ≤ NormSqLossScalar A b y)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hfd
                                          
    have hax : A x = b := (P0_normal_equation_scalar A b x hb).mp hfd
    exact satisfaction_global_min A b x hax
  · intro hmin
                                                       
    have hre : ∀ v : E, RCLike.re ⟪A x - b, A v⟫ = 0 := residual_orthogonal_of_global_min A b x hmin
    have horth : (A x - b) ∈ (Submodule.orthogonal (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))) :=
      mem_orthogonal_range_scalar hre
    have hax : A x ∈ LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :=
      LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hsub : (A x - b) ∈ LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F) :=
      Submodule.sub_mem (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) hax hb
    have hbot : (A x - b) = 0 := by
      have hmem : (A x - b) ∈
          (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) ⊓
          (Submodule.orthogonal (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))) := by
        exact Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hsub, horth⟩
      have hdisj : (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)) ⊓
          (Submodule.orthogonal (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))) = ⊥ := by
        exact Submodule.inf_orthogonal_eq_bot (LinearMap.range (A : E →ₗ[𝕜] F))
      have : (A x - b) ∈ (⊥ : Submodule 𝕜 F) := by simpa [hdisj] using hmem
      simpa using this
                            
    have hAx : A x = b := sub_eq_zero.mp hbot
    exact (P0_normal_equation_scalar A b x hb).mpr hAx
